ruling: FireRed/LeafGreen's own move descriptions, as its summary screen shows them, for every move the 151 learn by level or by machine and every move the game authors.

pokefirered.note: the FireRed disassembly; line breaks made spaces, "paralyzed" spelt "paralysed" as the battle lines spell it

descriptions.absorb: An attack that absorbs half the damage it inflicted to restore HP.
descriptions.acid: The foe is sprayed with a harsh, hide- melting acid that may lower DEFENSE.
descriptions.acid-armor: The user alters its cells to liquefy itself and sharply raise DEFENSE.
descriptions.aerial-ace: An extremely fast attack against one target. It can't be evaded.
descriptions.agility: The user relaxes and lightens its body to sharply boost its SPEED.
descriptions.air-cutter: The foe is hit with razor-like wind. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
descriptions.amnesia: Forgets about something and sharply raises SP. DEF.
descriptions.ancient-power: An ancient power is used to attack. It may also raise all the user's stats.
descriptions.aromatherapy: A soothing scent is released to heal all status problems in the user's party.
descriptions.astonish: An attack using a startling shout. It also may make the foe flinch.
descriptions.attract: If it is the other gender, the foe is made infatuated and unlikely to attack.
descriptions.aurora-beam: A rainbow-colored attack beam. It may lower the foe's ATTACK stat.
descriptions.barrage: Round objects are hurled at the foe to strike two to five times.
descriptions.barrier: The user creates a sturdy wall that sharply raises its DEFENSE stat.
descriptions.baton-pass: The user switches out, passing along any stat changes to the new battler.
descriptions.belly-drum: The user maximizes its ATTACK stat at the cost of half its full HP.
descriptions.bind: A long body or tentacles are used to bind the foe for two to five turns.
descriptions.bite: The user bites with vicious fangs. It may make the foe flinch.
descriptions.blizzard: The foe is blasted with a blizzard. It may freeze the foe solid.
descriptions.block: The user blocks the foe's way with arms spread wide to prevent escape.
descriptions.body-slam: The user drops its full body on the foe. It may leave the foe paralysed.
descriptions.bone-club: The foe is clubbed with a bone held in hand. It may make the foe flinch.
descriptions.bone-rush: The user strikes the foe with a bone in hand two to five times.
descriptions.bonemerang: The user throws a bone that hits the foe once, then once again on return.
descriptions.bounce: The user bounces on the foe on the 2nd turn. It may paralyse the foe.
descriptions.brick-break: An attack that also breaks any barrier like LIGHT SCREEN and REFLECT.
descriptions.bubble: A spray of bubbles hits the foe. It may lower the foe's SPEED stat.
descriptions.bubble-beam: A spray of bubbles strikes the foe. It may lower the foe's SPEED stat.
descriptions.bulk-up: The user bulks up its body to boost both its ATTACK and DEFENSE stats.
descriptions.bullet-seed: The user shoots seeds at the foe. Two to five seeds are shot at once.
descriptions.calm-mind: The user focuses its mind to raise the SP. ATK and SP. DEF stats.
descriptions.camouflage: Alters the user's type depending on the location's terrain.
descriptions.charge: The user charges power to boost the ELECTRIC move it uses next.
descriptions.clamp: The foe is clamped and squeezed by the user's shell for two to five turns.
descriptions.comet-punch: The foe is hit with a flurry of punches that strike two to five times.
descriptions.confuse-ray: The foe is exposed to a sinister ray that triggers confusion.
descriptions.confusion: A weak telekinetic attack that may also leave the foe confused.
descriptions.constrict: The foe is attacked with long tentacles or vines. It may lower SPEED.
descriptions.conversion: The user changes its type to match the type of one of its moves.
descriptions.conversion-2: The user changes type to make itself resistant to the last attack it took.
descriptions.cosmic-power: The user absorbs a mystic power to raise its DEFENSE and SP. DEF.
descriptions.counter: A retaliation move that counters any physical hit with double the damage.
descriptions.covet: A cutely executed attack that also steals the foe's hold item.
descriptions.crabhammer: A large pincer is used to hammer the foe. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
descriptions.cross-chop: The foe is hit with double chops. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
descriptions.crunch: The foe is crunched with sharp fangs. It may lower the foe's SP. DEF.
descriptions.curse: A move that works differently for the GHOST-type and all the other types.
descriptions.cut: A basic attack. It can be used to cut down thin trees and grass.
descriptions.defense-curl: The user curls up to conceal weak spots and raise its DEFENSE stat.
descriptions.destiny-bond: If the user faints, the foe delivering the final hit also faints.
descriptions.detect: Enables the user to evade all attacks. It may fail if used in succession.
descriptions.dig: An attack that hits on the 2nd turn. Can also be used to exit dungeons.
descriptions.disable: For a few turns, it prevents the foe from using the move it last used.
descriptions.dive: The user dives underwater on the first turn and strikes next turn.
descriptions.dizzy-punch: The foe is hit with a rhythmic punch that may leave it confused.
descriptions.double-edge: A reckless, life- risking tackle that also hurts the user a little.
descriptions.double-kick: Two legs are used to quickly kick the foe twice in one turn.
descriptions.double-slap: The foe is slapped repeatedly, back and forth, two to five times.
descriptions.double-team: The user creates illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.
descriptions.dragon-breath: The foe is hit with an incredible blast of breath that may also paralyse.
descriptions.dragon-claw: Sharp, huge claws hook and slash the foe quickly and with great power.
descriptions.dragon-dance: A mystic, powerful dance that boosts the user's ATTACK and SPEED stats.
descriptions.dragon-rage: The foe is hit with a shock wave that always inflicts 40- HP damage.
descriptions.dream-eater: Absorbs half the damage it inflicted on a sleeping foe to restore HP.
descriptions.drill-peck: A corkscrewing attack with the sharp beak acting as a drill.
descriptions.dynamic-punch: The foe is punched with the user's full power. It confuses the foe if it hits.
descriptions.earthquake: An earthquake that strikes all POKéMON in battle excluding the user.
descriptions.egg-bomb: A large egg is hurled with great force at the foe to inflict damage.
descriptions.ember: The foe is attacked with small flames. The foe may suffer a burn.
descriptions.encore: Makes the foe use the move it last used repeatedly for two to six turns.
descriptions.endeavor: Gains power the fewer HP the user has compared with the foe.
descriptions.endure: The user endures any hit with 1 HP left. It may fail if used in succession.
descriptions.explosion: The user explodes to inflict terrible damage even while fainting itself.
descriptions.extreme-speed: A blindingly speedy charge attack that always goes before any other.
descriptions.facade: An attack that is boosted if user is burned, poisoned, or paralysed.
descriptions.fake-out: An attack that hits first and causes flinching. Usable only on 1st turn.
descriptions.fake-tears: The user feigns crying to sharply lower the foe's SP. DEF stat.
descriptions.false-swipe: A restrained attack that always leaves the foe with at least 1 HP.
descriptions.feather-dance: The foe is covered with a mass of down that sharply cuts the ATTACK stat.
descriptions.feint-attack: The user draws up close to the foe disarmingly, then hits without fail.
descriptions.fire-blast: The foe is hit with an intense flame. It may leave the target with a burn.
descriptions.fire-punch: The foe is punched with a fiery fist. It may leave the foe with a burn.
descriptions.fire-spin: The foe is trapped in an intense spiral of fire that rages two to five turns.
descriptions.fissure: The foe is dropped into a fissure. The foe faints if it hits.
descriptions.flail: A desperate attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.
descriptions.flame-wheel: The user makes a fiery charge at the foe. It may cause a burn.
descriptions.flamethrower: The foe is scorched with intense flames. The foe may suffer a burn.
descriptions.flash: A blast of light that cuts the foe's accuracy. It also illuminates caves.
descriptions.flatter: Flattery is used to confuse the foe, but its SP. ATK also rises.
descriptions.fly: A 2-turn move that hits on the 2nd turn. Use it to fly to any known town.
descriptions.focus-energy: The user takes a deep breath and focuses to raise its critical-hit ratio.
descriptions.focus-punch: An attack that is executed last. The user flinches if hit beforehand.
descriptions.follow-me: The user draws attention to itself, making foes attack only the user.
descriptions.foresight: Completely negates the foe's efforts to heighten its ability to evade.
descriptions.frustration: This attack move grows more powerful the less the user likes its TRAINER.
descriptions.fury-attack: The foe is jabbed repeatedly with a horn or beak two to five times.
descriptions.fury-cutter: An attack that grows stronger on each successive hit.
descriptions.fury-swipes: The foe is raked with sharp claws or scythes two to five times.
descriptions.future-sight: Two turns after this move is used, the foe is attacked psychically.
descriptions.giga-drain: A harsh attack that absorbs half the damage it inflicted to restore HP.
descriptions.glare: The user intimidates the foe with the design on its belly to cause paralysis.
descriptions.growl: The user growls in a cute way, making the foe lower its ATTACK stat.
descriptions.growth: The user's body is forced to grow, raising the SP. ATK stat.
descriptions.grudge: If the user faints, this move deletes the PP of the move that finished it.
descriptions.guillotine: A vicious tearing attack with pincers. The foe will faint if it hits.
descriptions.gust: Strikes the foe with a gust of wind whipped up by wings.
descriptions.hail: A hailstorm lasting five turns damages all POKéMON except the ICE-type.
descriptions.harden: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to raise its DEFENSE stat.
descriptions.haze: Eliminates all stat changes among all POKéMON engaged in battle.
descriptions.headbutt: The user sticks its head out and rams. It may make the foe flinch.
descriptions.heat-wave: The user exhales a heated breath to attack. It may also inflict a burn.
descriptions.helping-hand: A move that boosts the power of the ally's attack in a battle.
descriptions.hidden-power: An attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the user.
descriptions.high-jump-kick: A strong jumping knee kick. If it misses, the user is hurt.
descriptions.horn-attack: The foe is jabbed with a sharply pointed horn to inflict damage.
descriptions.horn-drill: The horn is rotated like a drill to ram. The foe will faint if it hits.
descriptions.hydro-pump: A high volume of water is blasted at the foe under great pressure.
descriptions.hyper-beam: A severely damaging attack that makes the user rest on the next turn.
descriptions.hyper-fang: The foe is attacked with sharp fangs. It may make the foe flinch.
descriptions.hyper-voice: The user lets loose a horribly loud shout with the power to damage.
descriptions.hypnosis: Hypnotic suggestion is used to make the foe fall into a deep sleep.
descriptions.ice-beam: The foe is struck with an icy beam. It may freeze the foe solid.
descriptions.ice-punch: The foe is punched with an icy fist. It may leave the foe frozen.
descriptions.icicle-spear: Sharp icicles are fired at the foe. It strikes two to five times.
descriptions.icy-wind: A chilling wind is used to attack. It also lowers the SPEED stat.
descriptions.imprison: Prevents foes from using any move that is also known by the user.
descriptions.ingrain: The user lays roots that restore HP on every turn. It can't switch out.
descriptions.iron-tail: An attack with a steel-hard tail. It may lower the foe's DEFENSE stat.
descriptions.jump-kick: The user jumps up high, then kicks. If it misses, the user hurts itself.
descriptions.karate-chop: The foe is attacked with a sharp chop. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
descriptions.kinesis: The user distracts the foe by bending a spoon. It may lower accuracy.
descriptions.knock-off: Knocks down the foe's held item to prevent its use during the battle.
descriptions.leech-life: An attack that absorbs half the damage it inflicted to restore HP.
descriptions.leech-seed: A seed is planted on the foe to steal some HP for the user on every turn.
descriptions.leer: The foe is given an intimidating look that lowers its DEFENSE stat.
descriptions.lick: The foe is licked and hit with a long tongue. It may also paralyse.
descriptions.light-screen: A wall of light cuts damage from SP. ATK attacks for five turns.
descriptions.lock-on: The user locks on to the foe, making the next move sure to hit.
descriptions.lovely-kiss: The user forces a kiss on the foe with a scary face that induces sleep.
descriptions.low-kick: A low, tripping kick that inflicts more damage on heavier foes.
descriptions.mach-punch: A punch thrown at blinding speed. It is certain to strike first.
descriptions.magical-leaf: The foe is attacked with a strange leaf that cannot be evaded.
descriptions.magnitude: A ground-shaking attack against all standing POKéMON. Its power varies.
descriptions.mean-look: The foe is fixed with a mean look that prevents it from escaping.
descriptions.meditate: The user meditates to awaken its power and raise its ATTACK stat.
descriptions.mega-drain: A tough attack that drains half the damage it inflicted to restore HP.
descriptions.mega-kick: The foe is attacked by a kick fired with muscle-packed power.
descriptions.mega-punch: The foe is slugged by a punch thrown with muscle-packed power.
descriptions.megahorn: A brutal ramming attack delivered with a tough and impressive horn.
descriptions.memento: The user faints, but sharply lowers the foe's ATTACK and SP. ATK.
descriptions.metal-claw: The foe is attacked with steel claws. It may also raise the user's ATTACK.
descriptions.metal-sound: A horrible metallic screech is used to sharply lower the foe's SP. DEF.
descriptions.meteor-mash: The foe is hit with a hard, fast punch. It may also raise the user's ATTACK.
descriptions.metronome: Waggles a finger and stimulates the brain into using any move at random.
descriptions.mimic: The user copies the move last used by the foe for the rest of the battle.
descriptions.mind-reader: The user predicts the foe's action to ensure its next attack hits.
descriptions.minimize: The user compresses all the cells in its body to raise its evasiveness.
descriptions.mirror-coat: A retaliation move that pays back the foe's special attack double.
descriptions.mirror-move: The user counters the move last used by the foe with the same move.
descriptions.mist: The ally party is protected by a mist that prevents stat reductions.
descriptions.moonlight: Restores the user's HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
descriptions.mud-shot: The user attacks by hurling mud. It also reduces the foe's SPEED.
descriptions.mud-slap: Mud is hurled in the foe's face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.
descriptions.mud-sport: Weakens ELECTRIC- type attacks while the user is in the battle.
descriptions.night-shade: An attack with a mirage that inflicts damage matching the user's level.
descriptions.nightmare: A sleeping foe is shown a nightmare that inflicts some damage every turn.
descriptions.odor-sleuth: Completely negates the foe's efforts to heighten its ability to evade.
descriptions.outrage: The user thrashes about for two to three turns, then becomes confused.
descriptions.overheat: An intense attack that also sharply reduces the user's SP. ATK stat.
descriptions.pay-day: Numerous coins are hurled at the foe. Money is earned after battle.
descriptions.peck: The foe is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn.
descriptions.perish-song: Any battler that hears this faints in three turns unless it switches.
descriptions.petal-dance: The user attacks with petals for two to three turns, then gets confused.
descriptions.pin-missile: Sharp pins are shot at the foe and hit two to five times at once.
descriptions.poison-fang: The foe is bitten with toxic fangs. It may also badly poison the foe.
descriptions.poison-gas: The foe is sprayed with a cloud of toxic gas that may poison the foe.
descriptions.poison-powder: A cloud of toxic dust is scattered. It may poison the foe.
descriptions.poison-sting: The foe is stabbed with a toxic barb, etc. It may poison the foe.
descriptions.pound: A physical attack delivered with a long tail or a foreleg, etc.
descriptions.powder-snow: Blasts the foe with a snowy gust. It may cause freezing.
descriptions.protect: Enables the user to evade all attacks. It may fail if used in succession.
descriptions.psybeam: A peculiar ray is shot at the foe. It may leave the foe confused.
descriptions.psych-up: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the foe.
descriptions.psychic: A strong telekinetic attack. It may also lower the foe's SP. DEF stat.
descriptions.pursuit: An attack move that works especially well on a foe that is switching out.
descriptions.quick-attack: An almost invisibly fast attack that is certain to strike first.
descriptions.rage: An attack that becomes stronger each time the user is hit in battle.
descriptions.rain-dance: A heavy rain falls for five turns, powering up WATER- type moves.
descriptions.rapid-spin: An attack that frees the user from BIND, WRAP, LEECH SEED, and SPIKES.
descriptions.razor-leaf: The foe is hit with a cutting leaf. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
descriptions.recover: A self-healing move that restores HP by up to half of the user's maximum HP.
descriptions.recycle: A move that recycles a used item for use once more.
descriptions.reflect: A wall of light cuts damage from physical attacks for five turns.
descriptions.refresh: A self-healing move that cures the user of a poisoning, burn, or paralysis.
descriptions.rest: The user sleeps for two turns to fully restore HP and heal any status problem.
descriptions.return: This attack move grows more powerful the more the user likes its TRAINER.
descriptions.revenge: An attack move that gains in intensity if the target has hurt the user.
descriptions.reversal: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.
descriptions.roar: The foe is made to switch out with an ally. In the wild, the battle ends.
descriptions.rock-blast: The user hurls two to five hard rocks at the foe to attack.
descriptions.rock-smash: An attack that may also cut DEFENSE. It can also smash cracked boulders.
descriptions.rock-throw: The foe is attacked with a shower of small, easily thrown rocks.
descriptions.rock-tomb: Boulders are hurled at the foe. It also lowers the foe's SPEED if it hits.
descriptions.role-play: The user mimics the foe completely and copies the foe's ability.
descriptions.rolling-kick: A quick kick from a rolling spin. It may make the foe flinch.
descriptions.rollout: A 5-turn rolling attack that becomes stronger each time it hits.
descriptions.safeguard: It protects the user's party from all status problems for five turns.
descriptions.sand-attack: A lot of sand is hurled in the foe's face, reducing its accuracy.
descriptions.sand-tomb: The foe is trapped inside a painful sandstorm for two to five turns.
descriptions.sandstorm: A 5-turn sandstorm that damages all types except ROCK, GROUND, and STEEL.
descriptions.scary-face: Frightens the foe with a scary face to sharply reduce its SPEED.
descriptions.scratch: Hard, pointed, and sharp claws rake the foe.
descriptions.screech: An ear-splitting screech is emitted to sharply reduce the foe's DEFENSE.
descriptions.secret-power: An attack that may have an additional effect that varies with the terrain.
descriptions.seismic-toss: A gravity-fed throw that causes damage matching the user's level.
descriptions.self-destruct: The user blows up to inflict severe damage, even making itself faint.
descriptions.shadow-ball: A shadowy blob is hurled at the foe. May also lower the foe's SP. DEF.
descriptions.shadow-punch: The user throws a punch from the shadows. It cannot be evaded.
descriptions.sharpen: The user reduces its polygon count to sharpen edges and raise ATTACK.
descriptions.sheer-cold: The foe is attacked with ultimate cold that causes fainting if it hits.
descriptions.shock-wave: A rapid jolt of electricity strikes the foe. It can't be evaded.
descriptions.signal-beam: The foe is hit with a flashing beam that may also cause confusion.
descriptions.silver-wind: The foe is attacked with a silver dust. It may raise all the user's stats.
descriptions.sing: A soothing song in a calming voice lulls the foe into a deep slumber.
descriptions.skill-swap: The user employs its psychic power to swap abilities with the foe.
descriptions.skull-bash: The user raises its DEFENSE in the 1st turn, then attacks in the 2nd turn.
descriptions.sky-attack: A 2nd-turn attack move with a high critical-hit ratio. The foe may flinch.
descriptions.sky-uppercut: The user attacks with an uppercut thrown skywards with force.
descriptions.slam: The foe is struck with a long tail, vines, etc.
descriptions.slash: The foe is slashed with claws, etc. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
descriptions.sleep-powder: A sleep-inducing dust is scattered in high volume around a foe.
descriptions.sleep-talk: While asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.
descriptions.sludge: Toxic sludge is hurled at the foe. It may poison the target.
descriptions.sludge-bomb: Filthy sludge is hurled at the foe. It may poison the target.
descriptions.smog: The foe is attacked with exhaust gases. It may also poison the foe.
descriptions.smokescreen: An obscuring cloud of smoke or ink reduces the foe's accuracy.
descriptions.snatch: Steals the effects of the foe's healing or status- changing move.
descriptions.snore: An attack that can be used only while asleep. It may cause flinching.
descriptions.soft-boiled: Heals the user by up to half its full HP. It can be used to heal an ally.
descriptions.solar-beam: A 2-turn move that blasts the foe with absorbed energy in the 2nd turn.
descriptions.sonic-boom: The foe is hit with a shock wave that always inflicts 20- HP damage.
descriptions.spark: An electrically charged tackle that may also paralyse the foe.
descriptions.spike-cannon: Sharp spikes are fired at the foe to strike two to five times.
descriptions.spikes: A trap of spikes is laid around the foe's party to hurt foes switching in.
descriptions.spit-up: The power built using STOCKPILE is released at once for attack.
descriptions.spite: A move that cuts 2 to 5 PP from the move last used by the foe.
descriptions.splash: The user just flops and splashes around without having any effect.
descriptions.spore: The user scatters bursts of fine spores that induce sleep.
descriptions.steel-wing: The foe is hit with wings of steel. It may also raise the user's DEFENSE.
descriptions.stockpile: The user charges up power for use later. It can be used three times.
descriptions.stomp: The foe is stomped with a big foot. It may make the foe flinch.
descriptions.strength: The foe is slugged at maximum power. Can also be used to move boulders.
descriptions.string-shot: The foe is bound with strings shot from the mouth to reduce its SPEED.
descriptions.struggle: An attack that is used only if there is no PP. It also hurts the user.
descriptions.stun-spore: Paralyzing dust is scattered wildly. It may paralyse the foe.
descriptions.submission: A reckless, full- body throw attack that also hurts the user a little.
descriptions.substitute: The user creates a decoy using one- quarter of its full HP.
descriptions.sunny-day: The sun blazes for five turns, powering up FIRE-type moves.
descriptions.super-fang: The user attacks with sharp fangs and halves the foe's HP.
descriptions.superpower: A powerful attack, but it also lowers the user's ATTACK and DEFENSE stats.
descriptions.supersonic: The user generates odd sound waves. It may confuse the foe.
descriptions.surf: A big wave crashes down on the foe. Can also be used for crossing water.
descriptions.swagger: A move that makes the foe confused, but also sharply raises its ATTACK.
descriptions.swallow: The energy it built using STOCKPILE is absorbed to restore HP.
descriptions.sweet-scent: Allures the foe to reduce evasiveness. It also attracts wild POKéMON.
descriptions.swift: Star-shaped rays that never miss are fired at all foes in battle.
descriptions.swords-dance: A frenetic dance of fighting. It sharply raises the ATTACK stat.
descriptions.synthesis: Restores the user's HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
descriptions.tackle: A physical attack in which the user charges, full body, into the foe.
descriptions.tail-whip: The user wags its tail cutely, making the foe lower its DEFENSE stat.
descriptions.take-down: A reckless, full- body charge attack that also hurts the user a little.
descriptions.taunt: The foe is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves.
descriptions.teleport: Use it to flee from any wild POKéMON. Also warps to the last POKé CENTER.
descriptions.thief: An attack that may take the foe's held item if the user isn't holding one.
descriptions.thrash: The user rampages about for two to three turns, then becomes confused.
descriptions.thunder: A brutal lightning attack that may also leave the foe paralysed.
descriptions.thunder-punch: The foe is punched with an electrified fist. It may leave the foe paralysed.
descriptions.thunder-shock: An electric shock attack that may also leave the foe paralysed.
descriptions.thunder-wave: A weak electric shock that is sure to cause paralysis if it hits.
descriptions.thunderbolt: A strong electrical attack that may also leave the foe paralysed.
descriptions.tickle: The foe is made to laugh, reducing its ATTACK and DEFENSE stats.
descriptions.torment: It enrages the foe, making it incapable of using the same move successively.
descriptions.toxic: A move that badly poisons the foe. Its poison damage worsens every turn.
descriptions.transform: The user transforms into a copy of the foe with even the same move set.
descriptions.tri-attack: A simultaneous 3-beam attack that may paralyse, burn, or freeze the foe.
descriptions.trick: A move that tricks the foe into trading held items with the user.
descriptions.twineedle: The foe is stabbed twice with foreleg stingers. It may poison the foe.
descriptions.twister: A vicious twister attacks the foe. It may make the foe flinch.
descriptions.uproar: The user attacks in an uproar that prevents sleep for two to five turns.
descriptions.vice-grip: Huge, impressive pincers grip and squeeze the foe.
descriptions.vine-whip: The foe is struck with slender, whip- like vines.
descriptions.vital-throw: Makes the user attack after the foe. In return, it will not miss.
descriptions.water-gun: The foe is struck with a lot of water expelled forcibly from the mouth.
descriptions.water-pulse: An attack with a pulsing blast of water. It may also confuse the foe.
descriptions.water-sport: Weakens FIRE-type attacks while the user is in the battle.
descriptions.waterfall: A powerful charge attack. It can also be used to climb a waterfall.
descriptions.whirlwind: The foe is made to switch out with an ally. In the wild, the battle ends.
descriptions.will-o-wisp: A sinister, bluish white flame is shot at the foe to inflict a burn.
descriptions.wing-attack: The foe is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide.
descriptions.withdraw: The user withdraws its body in its hard shell, raising its DEFENSE stat.
descriptions.wrap: A long body or vines are used to wrap the foe for two to five turns.
descriptions.yawn: A huge yawn lulls the foe into falling asleep on the next turn.
descriptions.zap-cannon: An electric blast is fired like a cannon to inflict damage and paralyse.
